Name: Owl Scarecrows for AT (TheBigJB Update)
Author: thebigjb
Description:
I love the original Owl Scarecrows mod and I want to see it kept alive! 

This mod started because I made some small changes to the Alternative Texture version for my own private use that allowed me to use any owl texture for any scarecrow - normal, rare, or deluxe. (The original was limited and didn't support Deluxe Scarecrows because it wasn't updated.)

Then I started wondering if I could pull one off for Content Patcher & GMCM. So I made both versions! ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26184/]Click here[/url] for the Content Patcher version.)

[center][color=red][size=3]Artwork used with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936]Ankokou[/url]﻿﻿﻿, the original creator. [/size][/color][/center]

[b]Alternative Textures Features
[/b][list]
[*]Use the paintbucket to change any scarecrow you own to any one of the owl scarecrow options.
[*]Compatible with 1.6+
[*]Works with the latest version of Alternative Textures.
[/list]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718915106.png[/img]
[b]
Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
[list=1]
[/list][*]Download the mod file then unzip/extract it into your Stardew mods folder!
[*]Fire up the game, grab the paintbucket from Robin if you don't already have it.
[*]Use the paintbucket on any scarecrow you own to choose which skin you want to apply.
[/list]
